answer: A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The velvet counter is kept in vertex and knoll shows each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3170 identities would post 1407 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
